name: FindAndReplaceCellsInExcelWorksheetNode
label: Find and Replace Cells in Excel Worksheet
description: Finds and replaces values in a specified range within an Excel worksheet.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet in which to perform find and replace.

fields.name: FindWhat
fields.label: Find What
fields.description: The text to find in the worksheet.

fields.name: ReplaceWith
fields.label: Replace With
fields.description: The text to replace found values with.

fields.name: SearchMode
fields.label: Search Mode
fields.description: Specifies where to search: All Cells, or Range of Cells.

selectOptions.label: Find and Replace
selectOptions.description: Locates and replaces text in the worksheet.

selectOptions.label: All Cells
selectOptions.description: Searches all cells in the used range.

selectOptions.label: Range of Cells
selectOptions.description: Searches a specified range of cells.

fields.name: StartColumn
fields.label: Start Column
fields.description: The starting column of the range to search.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row of the range to search.

fields.name: EndColumn
fields.label: End Column
fields.description: The ending column of the range to search.

fields.name: EndRow
fields.label: End Row
fields.description: The ending row of the range to search.

fields.name: MatchCase
fields.label: Match Case
fields.description: Whether the search should be case-sensitive.

fields.name: MatchEntireCell
fields.label: Match Entire Cell
fields.description: Whether to match the entire cell contents.
